statement: For every complete finite simple SRG(99,14,1,2), let R count actual induced rook-nine vertex subsets once, r_T count those containing actual triangle T, d_T=6-r_T and D=sum_T d_T=6(231-R). Whenever D>0, every d_T=m>0 satisfies D>6m and therefore D>=6m+6. Equivalently d_T<=230-R for every T whenever R<231. In particular R=229 forces exactly twelve deficiency-one triangles and zero deficiency on every other triangle.

scope.description: Exact unrestricted target rook-deficiency necessary condition, eliminating the complete equality boundary of the earlier second-neighbor mass bound. R229 and R231 remain unexcluded.

assumptions: Complete finite simple SRG(99,14,1,2) with actual triangle and induced rook-nine vertex-subset counts.
The positive-deficiency inequality is conditioned on D>0; no positive m is assumed when D=0.

steps: Local defect degree identity and U=3D/2.
Non-strict D>=6m and complete equality geometry.
Upper Gram positivity forces equality support induced.
All uncovered-square corners lie on positive triangles.
Complete S pair-common-neighbor categories give C4(S)=6m+sum common-matching edges<=9m.
U=9m forces three identical matchings and an actual rook across a designated defect pair.
D is a multiple of six, so strictness strengthens the integer bound.
